paperTitle: COEXIST: An Interactive Story Decision-Making Game for Mental Health Awareness
centralContribution: This work presents COEXIST, a short, interactive story decision-making game designed to increase mental health awareness, specifically focusing on self-care as a form of prevention for mental disorders such as depression and social isolation.
